articles.title: Trump aprova fuzilar ex-major autor de massacre em base militar | G1
articles.standfirst: Nidal Hasan foi condenado à morte pelo ataque à base de Fort Hood, em 2009, que deixou 13 mortos. Essa será a primeira execução pelas Forças Armadas em mais de 60 anos.
articles.summary: Nidal Hasan foi condenado à morte pelo ataque à base de Fort Hood, em 2009, que deixou 13 mortos. Essa será a primeira execução pelas Forças Armadas em mais de 60 anos.
articles.body:
O ex-psiquiatra do Exército americano Nidal Hassan em foto sem data divulgada pelas autoridades — Foto: AP

O presidente dos Estados Unidos , Donald Trump , aprovou a execução por pelotão de fuzilamento de Nidal Malik Hasan , ex-major do Exército condenado à morte pelo ataque que deixou 13 mortos e 32 feridos em uma base militar no Texas em 2009. A decisão foi anunciada nesta segunda-feira (5).

Segundo o porta-voz-chefe do Pentágono, Sean Parnell, o presidente aprovou a execução após uma recomendação do secretário de Guerra, Pete Hegseth.

O secretário do Exército ficará responsável por definir a data, o horário e o local da execução, segundo Parnell. Até a publicação desta reportagem, essas informações não haviam sido divulgadas.

Hasan está no corredor da morte desde 2013 , quando um júri militar o condenou por 13 homicídios premeditados e 32 tentativas de homicídio pelo ataque ocorrido em Fort Hood, em 5 de novembro de 2009.

Na época, Hasan era major do Exército e trabalhava como psiquiatra. Ele abriu fogo dentro de uma instalação onde militares passavam por procedimentos antes e depois de missões no exterior. Doze dos 13 mortos e 30 dos 32 feridos eram militares.

Durante o julgamento, Hasan representou a si mesmo e admitiu ter planejado o atentado . Ele próprio apontou que desejava ser condenado à morte . O major foi considerado um "lobo solitário" da rede terrorisda da Al-Qaeda.

Segundo as investigações, o homem queria defender "irmãos muçulmanos" de uma guerra ilegal conduzida pelos Estados Unidos no Afeganistão. Nascido em território americano, ele é filho de pais palestinos.

Hasan ficou paraplégico após ser baleado durante o ataque e está preso na penitenciária militar de segurança máxima de Fort Leavenworth, no Kansas.

O caso passou por mais de uma década de recursos antes de chegar à fase em que a sentença poderia ser submetida ao presidente. Pela legislação militar americana, a pena de morte de um militar não pode ser executada sem aprovação presidencial.

Se a sentença for cumprida, será a primeira execução realizada pelas Forças Armadas dos Estados Unidos desde 1961.

articles.title: Rússia descarta peste pneumônica após morte de pesquisadora | G1
articles.standfirst: Técnica de laboratório de 28 anos morreu após suspeita de contaminação em instituto na Sibéria. Exames apontaram pneumonia de causa indeterminada.
articles.summary: Técnica de laboratório de 28 anos morreu após suspeita de contaminação em instituto na Sibéria. Exames apontaram pneumonia de causa indeterminada.
articles.body:
Presidente da Rússia, Vladimir Putin, em Moscou em 30 de abril de 2026 — Foto: Sputnik/Mikhail Metzel/Pool via Reuters

As autoridades russas tentaram, nesta segunda-feira (5), reduzir a preocupação após a morte de uma funcionária de um instituto especializado no combate à peste na Sibéria. Segundo o governo, exames realizados após o falecimento não detectaram sinais da doença, e a situação está "sob controle".

Daria Chipilova, de 28 anos, era técnica de laboratório do Instituto de Combate à Peste de Irkutsk. A morte causou preocupação depois que um veículo de comunicação informou que ela poderia ter contraído peste pneumônica após a quebra de um tubo de ensaio.

Uma comissão de especialistas, no entanto, concluiu que a causa da morte foi uma "pneumonia de etiologia indeterminada", segundo o governador da região de Irkutsk, Igor Kobzev.

A agência sanitária russa Rospotrebnadzor também informou que "não foi detectado nenhum microrganismo relacionado à atividade profissional da jovem em suas amostras biológicas", afirmou Kobzev no Telegram.

O governador disse ainda que a situação sanitária na região é "estável" e que nenhum outro funcionário do instituto procurou atendimento médico desde que a morte veio a público.

"A situação continua sob nosso controle e sob o controle dos especialistas", afirmou.

O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, disse nesta segunda-feira que o governo americano analisa "muito seriamente" os relatos sobre o caso na Rússia .

"Vamos ajudá-los tanto quanto pudermos", acrescentou.

O porta-voz do Kremlin, Dmitri Peskov, por sua vez, pediu aos jornalistas que consultem "os comunicados oficiais da Rospotrebnadzor em vez de boatos e especulações".

A peste é uma doença infecciosa causada por bactérias. A forma pneumônica é altamente contagiosa e pode ser fatal se não for tratada rapidamente, segundo a Organização Mundial da Saúde (OMS).

articles.title: Flávio Bolsonaro, PL, recebe apoio de Zema, Novo, e do ex-presidente Michel Temer | G1
articles.standfirst: O candidato à Presidência começou fazer reuniões para traçar estratégias para o segundo turno.
articles.summary: O candidato à Presidência começou fazer reuniões para traçar estratégias para o segundo turno.
articles.body:
A campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro , do PL , recebeu nesta segunda-feira (5) os apoios de Romeu Zema , do Partido Novo , e também do ex-presidente Michel Temer .

A apuração estava avançada quando Flávio Bolsonaro chegou ao QG de campanha em Brasília. Assim que foi confirmado o segundo turno, ele fez um pronunciamento de cerca de quatro minutos e comemorou o resultado:

"O Brasil quer mudança e eu fiquei muito feliz com o resultado em todas as regiões, todas as regiões. No meu Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Minas Gerais. Eu estou muito feliz com a possibilidade real de daqui a três semanas o Brasil dar uma resposta definitiva de que quer um governo moderno, um governo com menos ministérios, um governo que vai resgatar a democracia, um governo que vai indicar pelo menos quatro ministros pro Supremo Tribunal Federal que não vão tentar interferir em eleições. Eu estou preocupado com o futuro do Brasil, eu estou disputando o Brasil e assim que eu vou continuar me comportando nessas próximas três semanas: com uma campanha limpa, com alguém que não está preocupado com perpetuação no poder. Eu sou o único candidato que assumiu o compromisso pelo fim da reeleição porque eu só preciso de um mandato para colocar o brasileiro e a brasileira no centro do meu governo, para que eu possa atacar e resolver os problemas reais do Brasil. Eu quero a oportunidade de cuidar do Brasil, eu quero a oportunidade de cuidar do povo brasileiro, eu quero a oportunidade de cuidar de você que está me assistindo e assim que eu vou fazer: com muita energia, com muita alegria e com muita esperança porque o Brasil vai vencer! Bora, Brasil".

Flávio Bolsonaro, PL, recebe apoio de Zema, Novo, e do ex-presidente Temer — Foto: Jornal Nacional/ Reprodução

Nesta segunda-feira (5), Flávio Bolsonaro passou a maior parte do dia no QG de campanha, em reuniões com coordenadores de comunicação, marketing, logística e também com o candidato a vice-presidente, Alfredo Gaspar.

Em entrevista ao Estúdio i , da GloboNews , o presidente do PL, Valdemar Costa Neto, disse que, nesse segundo turno, o partido quer fazer novas alianças:

"Nós temos que nos aproximarmos novamente do União Brasil, do PP, do Republicanos, que quase todos trabalharam para o Bolsonaro. E nós temos que fazer, ter que ter um entendimento, ter que ter esse entendimento para que a gente possa ter esse equilíbrio. E nós temos que negociar para trazer esse pessoal, para trazer os candidatos, para trazer o apoio do Zema, para trazer o apoio do Caiado, para trazer o apoio do Cury. Quer dizer, nós temos que ter esse pessoal atendido e eles têm que sentir que nós vamos tocar o país para frente, porque ninguém vai querer tocar, vai querer parar o país".

Ao longo da tarde, a campanha recebeu adesões. O candidato do Novo, Romeu Zema, declarou apoio à campanha de Flávio, assim como o ex-presidente da República Michel Temer, do MDB .

Em entrevista na Casa Branca, o presidente americano, Donald Trump, foi questionado sobre as eleições no Brasil. Disse que está acompanhando, que acha que será muito acirrada, mas que considera que será uma grande vitória de Flávio Bolsonaro. Apertada, mas, na verdade, incrível, nas palavras de Trump.

No fim do dia, Flávio recebeu o governador eleito de São Paulo, Tarcísio de Freitas, do Republicanos.

articles.title: 2º turno: Flávio Bolsonaro, do PL, e Lula, do PT, disputam votos dos outros partidos e buscam motivar quem não foi às urnas | G1
articles.standfirst: O número de brasileiros que não foram às urnas passou de 33 milhões. A abstenção, que vem crescendo desde 2002, foi acima de 21% - o maior índice desde 1998.
articles.summary: O número de brasileiros que não foram às urnas passou de 33 milhões. A abstenção, que vem crescendo desde 2002, foi acima de 21% - o maior índice desde 1998.
articles.body:
A segunda-feira (5) marcou o começo da corrida presidencial para o segundo turno entre os candidatos Flávio Bolsonaro , do PL , e Lula , do PT . As duas campanhas disputam votos dos outros partidos e buscam motivar quem não foi às urnas.

Desde o fechamento das urnas às 17h, foram quase quatro horas de apuração até se confirmar que a eleição presidencial será decidida no segundo turno.

“20h56, hora de Brasília. Flávio Bolsonaro, do PL , vai para o segundo turno com Lula, presidente da República, candidato à reeleição pelo PT”, anunciou César Tralli.

Flávio Bolsonaro esteve à frente durante toda a apuração. Às 17h22, com menos de 1,5% das urnas apuradas, Flávio tinha 48,85% dos votos válidos. Lula, 42,5%. Depois das 18h, Flávio chegou a passar dos 51% - o que indicaria eleição definida no primeiro turno. Lula tinha pouco mais de 40%. Mas, a partir daí, com o avanço da apuração em regiões onde Lula teve desempenho melhor, a diferença começou a diminuir.

Disputa presidencial entre Flávio Bolsonaro, do PL, e Lula, do PT — Foto: Jornal Nacional/ Reprodução

“A gente vê aqui, Tralli, que são duas linhas que nunca se encontraram, que não houve ultrapassagem, mas que houve, sim, e está havendo muito claramente aqui um estreitamento, que é esse estreitamento que está mostrando para a gente a possibilidade, a perspectiva de haver segundo turno entre eles”, disse Renata Lo Prete.

Com todas as urnas apuradas, Flávio Bolsonaro ficou com 47,03% dos votos válidos, mais de 56 milhões de votos. Lula recebeu 45,16% , com quase 54 milhões . Uma diferença de 2.225.000 votos ou 1,87 ponto percentual.

O mapa eleitoral mostra onde esse resultado foi construído e o que mudou em relação ao primeiro turno de quatro anos atrás. Em 2022, quando Lula enfrentou Jair Bolsonaro , o petista venceu o primeiro turno em 14 estados. Bolsonaro venceu em 12, mais o Distrito Federal. No domingo (4), Flávio venceu em 14 estados e no Distrito Federal. Lula ficou na frente em 12.

Em Minas Gerais, Lula tinha vencido há quatro anos no primeiro turno. Agora, perdeu para Flávio Bolsonaro por quase a mesma diferença. No Tocantins, outra virada. Lula venceu em 2022. Agora, a maioria dos votos foi para Flávio Bolsonaro. Lula também teve votação menor na Bahia, onde, historicamente, o PT tem boa vantagem. Ele venceu, mas com uma vantagem menor do que em 2022. No maior colégio eleitoral do Brasil, Jair Bolsonaro havia ficado sete pontos percentuais a frente de Lula no primeiro turno de 2022. Agora, Flávio Bolsonaro venceu por mais de 13 pontos percentuais.

Flávio Bolsonaro venceu em quatro das cinco regiões do país. No Sudeste, a vantagem de Flávio Bolsonaro foi de pouco mais de 11 pontos percentuais. No Sul, de quase 29 pontos. No Centro-Oeste, foi de quase 24 pontos. No Norte, foi mais apertado, 4,5 pontos de diferença. E, no Nordeste, vantagem foi de Lula - quase 33 pontos.

O número de brasileiros que não foram às urnas passou de 33 milhões. A abstenção, que vem crescendo desde 2002, foi acima de 21% - o maior índice desde 1998. Com uma diferença apertada, Flávio e Lula partem agora para a disputa desses eleitores e dos votos dos candidatos derrotados. Flávio, para manter a dianteira. Lula, para tentar virar o jogo.

articles.title: Brasileiro é preso nos EUA após usar roupa de agente do ICE em votação | G1
articles.standfirst: Segundo autoridades, suspeito circulava de forma agressiva em centro de votação em Miami. Ele foi acusado de intimidação de eleitores, tentativa de suborno e uso indevido de insígnias policiais.
articles.summary: Segundo autoridades, suspeito circulava de forma agressiva em centro de votação em Miami. Ele foi acusado de intimidação de eleitores, tentativa de suborno e uso indevido de insígn
articles.body:
Um brasileiro de 46 anos foi preso no último domingo (4) após aparecer vestido como um agente do Serviço de Imigração e Controle de Alfândegas dos Estados Unidos (ICE, na sigla em inglês) em um local de votação das eleições brasileiras Miami, na Flórida.

Segundo o gabinete do xerife do condado de Miami-Dade, Danilo Silva circulava pelo campus de Kendall do Miami Dade College, onde brasileiros votavam, usando boné e jaqueta com identificação do ICE, óculos escuros, máscara cobrindo o rosto e botas táticas.

De acordo com o relatório policial, ele caminhava pelos locais de votação e abordava pessoas na intenção de causar medo entre os eleitores. A NBC filmou o momento da prisão.

Após receber as denúncias, agentes uniformizados e investigadores à paisana passaram a monitorar a área. Em determinado momento, Silva foi confrontado por dois homens, um deles filmando a situação. Os envolvidos iniciaram uma discussão, e os investigadores intervieram.

Danilo Silva foi preso por policiais à paisana após intimidar eleitores brasileiros vestindo a roupa dos agentes do ICE — Foto: Reprodução: Redes Sociais

Questionado pelos policiais, Silva admitiu que não era agente federal. Segundo o relato, ele afirmou que as roupas eram uma "fantasia" comprada pela internet, na Amazon.

Ainda de acordo com as autoridades, o homem disse que havia comparecido ao local para votar usando uma camisa da seleção brasileira. Depois, retornou ao carro, trocou de roupa e vestiu o uniforme semelhante ao utilizado por agentes do ICE.

Aos investigadores, Silva afirmou que queria apenas "ver a reação das pessoas".

Danilo Silva alegou às autoridades que só usou a fantasia para "ver a reação das pessoas" — Foto: Foto: Miami-Dade Corrections and Rehabilitation

Ele foi preso em flagrante. Segundo o relatório da polícia, durante a abordagem, ele ficou exaltado e ameaçou um dos investigadores, dizendo que ele se arrependeria da decisão de prendê-lo.

Segundo o Miami Herald, em seguida, Silva tentou subornar os policiais para ser liberado. De acordo com o jornal, ele ofereceu dinheiro e disse que poderia mostrar a transferência pelo celular.

Ele foi levado para o centro de detenção Turner Guilford Knight. Ele foi acusado de intimidação de eleitores, tentativa de suborno, uso ilegal de insígnias das forças de segurança e conduta desordeira.

Danilo Silva alegou às autoridades que só usou a fantasia para "ver a reação das pessoas" — Foto: Reprodução: NBC

articles.title: Bengaluru gym trainer ‘strangled’ at anniversary party; cops suspect accused were intoxicated
articles.summary: Bengaluru gym trainer Nandan, 25, died after an alleged assault during a gym anniversary after-party in Kempapura; police arrested three and are probing drugs/alcohol.
articles.body: BENGALURU: What began as a celebration to mark a gym’s first anniversary ended in tragedy, with a 25-year-old trainer allegedly assaulted to death following a quarrel among a group of trainers at a flat in Kempapura. Police have arrested three accused in connection with the death.The deceased, M Nandan, was a resident of Jakkur Layout. The accused named in a complaint filed by Nandan’s mother, Manjula, are Vishwanath, 22, Sharath, 27, Nishanth, 24 and Anush.Nandan, who was an only child, is survived by his mother and father, Mahendra, who works as a mason. Nandan was employed as a gym trainer at Masiv Fitness in Sahakaranagar for the last one year.According to the complaint, after the gym celebrations ended, Nandan, along with three accused, went to the residence of Anush, a trainee under Vishwanath. Anush lives in a flat (Prestige Misty Waters Apartments) in Kempapura, near Hebbal.Manjula alleged that Vishwanath, Sharath, Nishanth and Anush were involved in a quarrel and assault that led to her son’s death. Vishwanath and Sharath were also injured during the altercation.A murder case under Section 103 of the BNS was registered at Amruthahally police station, and an investigation is going on under the supervision of assistant commissioner of police (Sampigehalli sub-division) Chandan Kumar.Deputy commissioner of police (north-east) GK Mithun Kumar said, “Vishwanth was Anush’s trainer. At Anush’s house, deceased Nandan was assaulted, resulting in his death. The murder appears to be over personal reasons. Three accused people have been arrested. They are being interrogated in detail to ascertain the exact reason for the assault.”Cops suspect accused consumed dugs and alcoholA senior police officer said awards were presented to trainers and customers during the gym’s anniversary celebrations, following which a party was held at the gym.After Anush returned home, the other trainers asked him to let them stay at his house until the following morning. Though Anush initially refused, they allegedly persuaded him to allow them to stay.Anush then went to sleep in his room, while Nandan and the three arrested accused remained in the hall and continued partying. Between 3.30am and 4am on Oct 4, a quarrel broke out among them, which soon turned violent.The group allegedly assaulted each other, during which the bathroom mirror and handwash basin were damaged, the officer said.Nandan sustained multiple injuries to his body. Doctors who conducted the postmortem examination informed police that he had sustained several injuries and that his death appeared to have been caused by strangulation.Police suspect that the three arrested accused may have consumed drugs during the party. Their samples have been collected for medical examination, and police are awaiting the reports.Rushed to hospital in ambulanceAnush, who was sleeping in the room, told police that he woke up around 10.30am to find Nandan, with injuries on his body, lying unconscious.He immediately made a video call to a doctor and on his suggestion, he called an ambulance and rushed Nandan to a nearby hospital. The doctors declared him brought dead around 11.30 am.The assaulters were in his house without bothering to check on Nandan till then, an officer said.“The sequence of the crime and the role of Anush are being verified. The arrested persons are not revealing the exact reason for the fight. articles.title: Lucknow floods: 60 boats deployed, more on way, UP govt steps up relief
articles.summary: Lucknow floods: Admin deploys 60 boats in Faizullaganj, more motorised boats due; relief kits distributed as Gomti river levels rise.
articles.body: LUCKNOW: The district administration has intensified flood relief operations in low-lying areas as rising Gomti River levels continue to inundate several localities, prompting deployment of additional boats, distribution of relief kits and tighter security in affected neighbourhoods.District magistrate Vishakh G said nine gram panchayats in Bakshi Ka Talab tehsil remain waterlogged. Within the Lucknow Municipal Corporation limits, Faizullaganj and nearby settlements such as Mama Colony, Lauramau and Daud Nagar are among the worst hit, with water entering residential lanes and disrupting movement.Relief kits supplied by the Uttar Pradesh relief commissioner’s office are being distributed to affected families. Officials said each kit contains 10 kg wheat flour, 10 kg rice, 10 kg potatoes, along with chana, pulses, bottled drinking water and other essential items.To maintain connectivity and speed up relief delivery, the administration has deployed 60 boats in Faizullaganj. Vishakh G said more than 20 motorised boats from Ayodhya and other districts are expected to arrive by Tuesday, which is likely to expand evacuation capability and allow residents to commute for basic needs.Security has been stepped up in submerged localities, with SDRF boats assisting local police in patrolling flooded stretches and monitoring locked homes. The district magistrate said one person was recently arrested for allegedly attempting to steal from abandoned houses in an inundated area.Calling the situation challenging, Vishakh G appealed for public cooperation and urged residents to follow official advisories.Meanwhile, executive engineer Mukesh Kumar Vaish of the irrigation department’s Gomti river division reported that the water level at Gau Ghat was 108.45 metres on Monday evening, while the Central Water Commission’s Hanuman Setu gauge recorded 107 metres and the Gomti Barrage level was about 106.75 metres.Vaish said differences in readings occur due to the river’s natural gradient, with slopes of around 10–15 cm per km leading to variations between gauge points. articles.title: Nepal ends flood search with over 5,000 still missing, including 189 Indians
articles.summary: Nepal on Monday suspended all non-essential search and rescue operations 40 days after the Aug 26 Bhotekoshi-Trishuli floods, which left 1,455 people dead
articles.body: Nepal on Monday suspended all non-essential search and rescue operations 40 days after the Aug 26 Bhotekoshi-Trishuli floods, which left 1,455 people dead and 5,285 missing. It is now shifting focus to reconstruction and rehabilitation.Those still unaccounted for include 189 Indians and dozens of people of Indian origin holding foreign passports.The decision was taken at a meeting of National Council for Disaster Risk Reduction and Management, chaired by PM Balendra Shah. It followed recommendations from district disaster management committees, National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA) and teams that inspected flood-hit areas.The council recommended that the finance ministry approve Nepalese Rs 559 billion (Rs 35,000 crore) for 504 reconstruction and rehabilitation programmes submitted by ministries and agencies, with NDRRMA tasked with seeking additional funds for projects whose costs were yet to be assessed.Latest data from Nepal's tourism department showed 606 foreign tourists from 36 countries missing. Indians formed the largest group at 189, followed by 65 Americans, 55 Malaysians, 54 Ukrainians, 37 Chinese, 33 each from Australia and Latvia, 32 British nationals and 30 Canadians. Another 188 Nepalese tourists were also missing.Separately compiled figures from Indian states showed 85 missing from Tamil Nadu, 37 from West Bengal, 30 from Gujarat, 25 from Telangana, 22 from UP, 13 each from Karnataka and Andhra, 12 from Bihar, over 10 from Maharashtra and four from Odisha.You use AI every day. articles.title: Incêndio destrói apartamento em condomínio no Parque Pindorama, em SL | G1
articles.standfirst: Fogo começou em um dos quartos e se espalhou para outros cômodos do imóvel. Segundo o Corpo de Bombeiros, móveis foram destruídos e parte do telhado foi consumida pelas chamas.
articles.summary: Fogo começou em um dos quartos e se espalhou para outros cômodos do imóvel. Segundo o Corpo de Bombeiros, móveis foram destruídos e parte do telhado foi consumida pelas chamas.
articles.body:
Um incêndio atingiu um apartamento do Residencial Jomar Moraes, localizado na Rua Ipixuna, no bairro Parque Pindorama, em São Luís , na madrugada desta terça-feira (6). Ninguém ficou ferido.

Segundo o Corpo de Bombeiros Militar do Maranhão (CBMMA), a ocorrência foi registrada em um imóvel do bloco 3 do condomínio. No apartamento moram um casal e quatro filhos.

Ao chegar ao endereço, os bombeiros constataram que o fogo havia atingido principalmente um dos quartos. De acordo com a equipe que atendeu a ocorrência, a forte ventilação contribuiu para que as chamas se espalhassem para outros cômodos.

O incêndio provocou grandes danos no imóvel. As chamas atingiram paredes e laje, além de consumirem parte do telhado nas regiões do quarto e da cozinha. Entre os bens destruídos estavam cama, guarda-roupa, mesa e cadeiras. Conforme o relato dos bombeiros, houve perda dos bens existentes no local.

Incêndio destrói apartamento em condomínio no Parque Pindorama, em São Luís — Foto: Divulgação/CBMMA

Durante o combate, a equipe realizou o resfriamento da área atingida. Uma segunda guarnição foi enviada para apoiar a ocorrência e, quando chegou, encontrou o incêndio já controlado.

Os militares então realizaram o trabalho de rescaldo, que consiste na verificação dos ambientes atingidos e na eliminação de possíveis focos de calor que possam provocar uma nova ignição.

Após a inspeção e sem a identificação de novos focos de incêndio, a ocorrência foi encerrada. Os bombeiros também repassaram orientações de segurança aos moradores.

As causas do incêndio ainda serão investigadas.

articles.title: Coreia do Sul investiga ataques a bancos com possível uso de IA | G1
articles.standfirst: Ataques expuseram dados de clientes de pelo menos sete instituições financeiras; polícia abriu investigação e autoridades identificaram 28 endereços de IP suspeitos em 12 países.
articles.summary: Ataques expuseram dados de clientes de pelo menos sete instituições financeiras; polícia abriu investigação e autoridades identificaram 28 endereços de IP suspeitos em 12 países.
articles.body:
A Coreia do Sul investiga uma série de ataques cibernéticos contra instituições financeiras após o presidente Lee Jae Myung afirmar nesta terça-feira (6) que há indícios de uso de inteligência artificial (IA) em parte das invasões.

Os ataques atingiram pelo menos sete empresas do setor financeiro e expuseram informações pessoais de clientes. Entre as instituições afetadas estão os bancos Shinhan, KB Kookmin e Hana, segundo autoridades sul-coreanas e a agência de notícias Yonhap.

"Em alguns casos de invasão, surgiram indícios do uso de IA, causando considerável preocupação e ansiedade na população", afirmou Lee durante uma reunião do gabinete. O presidente determinou uma investigação rápida e pediu que recursos e equipes fossem concentrados para reduzir os danos.

A polícia sul-coreana abriu uma investigação sobre os ataques. Uma equipe com 28 integrantes foi formada para apurar o caso e verificar possíveis violações da legislação de redes e informações.

Um dos casos envolve o Shinhan Bank. Segundo a Yonhap, informações de aproximadamente 25 mil clientes foram expostas, incluindo nomes, números de telefone e renda anual.

No Hana Bank, dados pessoais de 89 clientes foram vazados. O Woori Bank e o NH Nonghyup Bank também foram alvo de tentativas de invasão, mas conseguiram bloquear o acesso antes que informações pessoais fossem expostas.

O Financial Services Commission (FSC), órgão responsável pela supervisão do setor financeiro, afirmou que houve uma sequência de ataques contra diferentes tipos de instituições, incluindo bancos comerciais, bancos de poupança e empresas especializadas em crédito.

Até o momento, as autoridades não informaram que valores tenham sido retirados das contas dos clientes. O principal problema identificado é a exposição de informações pessoais, que podem ser usadas posteriormente em golpes e fraudes.

O Serviço de Supervisão Financeira da Coreia do Sul (FSS) identificou 28 endereços de IP associados às tentativas de invasão. Eles estavam ligados a servidores em 12 países, incluindo Estados Unidos e Japão. As autoridades ainda não conseguiram determinar a origem de todos os endereços.

Os endereços foram compartilhados com instituições financeiras para ajudar os bancos a identificar novas tentativas de invasão e reforçar seus sistemas de segurança

A identificação dos IPs, porém, não significa que os responsáveis pelos ataques estejam nesses países. Um endereço de IP pode ser usado como intermediário ou estar associado a servidores comprometidos.

As autoridades sul-coreanas ainda não divulgaram qual ferramenta de inteligência artificial teria sido utilizada nos ataques.

Segundo a Reuters, o governo também não informou até agora a dimensão completa dos vazamentos nem os detalhes sobre as ferramentas de IA envolvidas.

O jornal britânico Financial Times, porém, informou que especialistas encontraram indícios relacionados ao Artex, uma ferramenta de código aberto que utiliza IA para identificar e testar vulnerabilidades em sistemas de computador.

A ferramenta teria sido associada a alguns dos ataques, mas a investigação ainda está em andamento.

O caso ocorre em um momento de aumento da preocupação internacional sobre o uso de agentes de IA em ataques cibernéticos. Em setembro, autoridades da Austrália disseram que um agente de IA da OpenAI havia conseguido acesso não autorizado a arquivos de um portal de dados de saúde do governo australiano.

No Canadá, uma empresa de pesquisa afirmou que agentes de IA tentaram invadir um site do governo, embora as autoridades canadenses tenham dito não haver indicação de que os sistemas tenham sido comprometidos.

Governo quer usar IA para se defender de ataques

O presidente da Comissão de Serviços Financeiros, Lee Eog-weon, convocou uma reunião de emergência com reguladores, associações do setor e executivos das instituições afetadas.

Ele pediu o mais alto nível de vigilância e defendeu que as empresas financeiras desenvolvam sistemas capazes de usar IA para identificar e bloquear ataques feitos com IA.

O governo sul-coreano também montou uma operação de resposta emergencial 24 horas e pediu a provedores de serviços de nuvem que bloqueiem atividades provenientes de endereços de IP considerados suspeitos.

A primeira-ministra Han Seong-sook também determinou uma revisão dos sistemas de proteção de informações do país. Segundo ela, os ataques mostram que as atuais medidas de segurança podem não ser suficientes diante da evolução das ferramentas de IA.

As investigações continuam, e as autoridades ainda não identificaram publicamente os responsáveis pelos ataques.

articles.body:
Arthur Henrique (PL) durante votação para o governo de Rorama neste domingo (4) — Foto: Ascom/Divulgação

Arthur Henrique (PL) foi eleito governador de Roraima neste domingo (4) e venceu em 13 dos 15 municípios do estado, com 69,13% dos votos válidos . O segundo colocado, Soldado Sampaio (Republicanos), teve 29,25% e ganhou em apenas duas cidades.

A vitória de Arthur no primeiro turno desse domingo encerrou uma disputa iniciada em junho . Ele e Sampaio já haviam concorrido ao governo na eleição suplementar . Na ocasião, Arthur obteve 60% dos votos válidos, mas o resultado não foi definido pela Justiça Eleitoral porque o registro da candidatura estava sub judice. Sampaio ficou em segundo luga r , com 35%. Agora, os dois voltaram a se enfrentar.

Arthur venceu em Alto Alegre, Amajari, Boa Vista , Bonfim, Cantá, Caracaraí, Caroebe, Iracema, Mucajaí, Pacaraima, Rorainópolis, São João da Baliza e São Luiz do Anauá. Soldado Sampaio venceu em Uiramutã e Normandia.

Foram registrados 331.959 votos na eleição para governador de Roraima. Desse total, 319.336 foram votos válidos, 3.677 votos brancos e 8.869 votos nulos. O estado teve ainda 68.644 eleitores que não compareceram às urnas, o que representa 17,14% do eleitorado apto .

Arthur é ex-prefeito de Boa Vista, capital de Roraima. Ele concorreu com outros quatro candidatos, sendo eles Rosi Aires, Farah Mesquita, e liderou as três pesquisas eleitorais encomendadas pela Rede Amazônica.

Alto Alegre: 13.424 eleitores aptos a votar

Boa Vista: 241.187 eleitores aptos a votar

Arthur Henrique: 140.548 votos (73,40%);

Caracaraí: 15.328 eleitores aptos a votar

Normandia: 9.705 eleitores aptos a votar

Pacaraima: 9.775 eleitores aptos a votar

Rorainópolis: 25.829 eleitores aptos a votar

São João da Baliza: 5.742 eleitores aptos a votar

São Luiz do Anauá: 6.102 eleitores aptos a votar

Arthur Henrique Brandão Machado é natural de Boa Vista e tem 44 anos. Foi eleito prefeito de Boa Vista pela primeira vez em 2020, com 116.792 votos (85,36%). Depois, foi reeleito em 2024, com 133.180 votos (75,18 %).

Estudou Engenharia Elétrica na Universidade de São Paulo (USP), mas não concluiu o curso. Antes da política, trabalhou em multinacionais do setor de tecnologia, como a Siemens e Capgemini, segundo a assessoria.

O vice-governador eleito na chapa de Arthur é empresário Haroldo Cathedral (Novo). Ela concorreram com pela coligação "Unidos por Roraima", formada por PL e Novo, e teve como slogan "Bora resolver".

Ingressou em um cargo político eletivo pela primeira vez em 2017, quando foi eleito vice da ex-prefeita Teresa Surita (MDB), de quem teve apoio nas eleições de 2020 e 2024. Antes disso, foi secretário extraordinário de Inclusão Digital em 2013 e titular da Secretaria Municipal de Educação e Cultura em 2019.

Arthur é casado com Nathália Cortez Brandão, atual secretária municipal de Gestão Social, e pai de quatro meninas.

articles.title: MrBeast spends $1.04 million-plus on a 202-day challenge that sends his YouTube views soaring
articles.summary: MrBeast has turned another outrageous challenge into a record-breaking YouTube moment.
articles.body: MrBeast has turned another outrageous challenge into a record-breaking YouTube moment. Jimmy Donaldson’s latest video, which locked four contestants inside a grocery store until they ate their way out, has become his most-watched video in a single 24-hour period. The challenge offered a $1 million prize, but the scale of the production may have cost far more than viewers first imagined.MrBeast’s grocery store challenge breaks YouTube recordThe premise sounded simple: four people enter a fully stocked grocery store, eat everything they can and eventually walk away with $1 million. In reality, the challenge became a marathon that lasted 202 days.The contestants were not simply spending a long day surrounded by food. The store had to function as a temporary living space, while a production team remained involved throughout the challenge. The sheer length of the experiment made the video far more demanding than a standard MrBeast production.Viewers responded in huge numbers. The video crossed 98 million views in less than 48 hours, while MrBeast said the average viewer watched for more than 20 minutes.He also celebrated the response on X, writing:“New video is our most viewed video ever in 24 hours but more importantly, it has 10,000+ comments saying it’s our BEST video ever (literally). Even though I’ve been making content for 17 years now I still think my best days are ahead, appreciate you all ❤️❤️”The milestone adds another major achievement to a channel that already has more than 519 million subscribers.MrBeast’s $1 million prize makes the video even biggerThe prize alone made the challenge expensive, but the contestants also received another surprise during the lengthy ordeal. On Day 100, MrBeast reportedly gave $40,000 to their families, with each family receiving $10,000.By the end, the four participants completed the challenge and collected the $1 million grand prize. That puts the known cash giveaways at a minimum of $1.04 million, before accounting for the grocery store, food, construction, staffing and production costs.MrBeast has previously demonstrated a willingness to spend millions on ambitious videos. His real-life Squid Game project reportedly cost around $4 million, while he has also revealed productions costing more than $10 million.The exact budget for the grocery store challenge remains unclear. Still, its early performance suggests the gamble is paying off in audience attention.The achievement also comes with an important distinction. YouTube treats music videos separately in many viewing records, meaning BTS’ “Butter,” which reached 108.2 million views in 24 hours, remains a different benchmark.For MrBeast, however, the latest result is another sign that his appetite for bigger, stranger challenges continues to translate into massive audiences.You use AI every day. articles.title: Satellites map nearly 2,000 valleys and a buried mountain range beneath Greenland ice, revealing a vast subglacial network across the ice sheet
articles.summary: Beneath the Greenland Ice Sheet lies a vast, island-wide network of valleys.
articles.body: Beneath the Greenland Ice Sheet lies a vast, island-wide network of valleys. The team applied Ice Flow Perturbation Analysis to surface elevation and velocity observations and manually mapped 1,943 subglacial valleys, 34% of which are not present in BedMachine Greenland. According to a paper published in Geophysical Research Letters titled ‘A Vast Valley Network Beneath the Greenland Ice Sheet’, the network covers 74% of the ice sheet, compared with 39% in BedMachine. They also describe a subglacial mountain range south-east of the Northeast Greenland Ice Stream. In their view, the valleys' orientation and branching angles point to tectonic inheritance and a long-term groundwater influence.Why does BedMachine Greenland have gaps in subglacial valley mappingAccording to the study, mapping the bed along the margin of the Greenland Ice Sheet was transformed by reconciling measurements of ice thickness and surface velocity using the principle of mass conservation. The authors write that this method cannot be applied to the slower-flowing interior, where ice thickness observations are sparse. In the plain language summary, they say it leaves three-quarters of the ice sheet with poorly resolved bedrock topography. For the 150-metre-resolution BedMachine Greenland product, only 4.4% of ice-sheet grid cells include a radar observation.The interior and slower-flowing margins of that product are unrealistically smooth compared with the periphery, but pockmarked along survey lines by sparsely sampled valleys. The authors note that ice flow and subglacial water drainage tend to focus toward such valleys. Their alternative uses the fact that significant bumps and troughs in the bed can produce detectable variations on the surface. The method relies on bed-to-surface signal transfer theory and fine-resolution maps of surface elevation and velocity. It was developed by Ockenden and colleagues for Antarctica and is modified here for Greenland. According to the paper, the inputs are the GrIMP version 2 digital elevation model and the MEaSUREs Multi-year Greenland Ice Sheet Velocity Mosaic. Both are resampled onto the 150-metre BedMachine grid, and ice thickness comes from BedMachine Greenland version 6.How did researchers map 1,943 subglacial valleysThe researchers traced valley centrelines by hand at a scale of 1:750,000. They focused on valleys at least 10 kilometres long and 1 kilometre wide, the same criteria used by MacGregor and colleagues in 2024. The paper reports 1,943 mapped subglacial valleys. Of these, 34% are identified by the new method and are not present in BedMachine. The authors add that 52% of the valleys visible in BedMachine are extended farther by the new method. They state that many valleys resolved by mass conservation along the periphery extend much farther inland, sometimes hundreds of kilometres more than in BedMachine.Subglacial valleys confine the flow of nearly all of Greenland's 239 largest outlet glaciers, those with termini at least 1.5 kilometres wide. Most of these, about 70%, are extended farther upstream in the blended topography. According to the authors, most that are not extended lie in the south-east drainage basin and are relatively small, with discharge below 1 gigatonne per year. Based on mapped valley presence in a 10-kilometre grid, the paper reports that the areal extent of the valley network is nearly doubled in the blended topography, at 74% of the ice sheet, compared with 39% in BedMachine. The authors say this extent is limited mainly by where the blended map does not use the new method, mostly because of disrupted basal units in the northern ice sheet.What did researchers find beneath Greenland’s iceThe authors write that their analyses are consistent with the hypothesis that alpine-style subglacial geomorphology dominates the region south-east of the Northeast Greenland Ice Stream and next to the eastern highlands. BedMachine only hints at substantial relief there. The new method reveals a subglacial mountain range with an interconnected valley network, with increasingly greater relief to the east. The authors state that this network spans the transition from a likely frozen bed to the south to a likely thawed bed to the north, closer to the ice stream. They add that several deeply incised valleys slope approximately radially inland from this region. They describe these as preferential pathways for past subglacial or glaciofluvial erosion beneath what is now slow-moving and likely cold-based ice.In far southern Greenland, the paper says the new method also generates rough subglacial topography. There the ice is presumed to be warmer, and firn aquifers are more common, which limits the success of radar sounding and leaves BedMachine unnaturally smooth. The study reports that the subglacial southern highlands have similar relief to the coastal regions, and that this relief extends north into a valley network less clearly visible in either the surface or BedMachine. Automated mapping outlined 22 larger dendritic basins, each over 10,000 square kilometres. In southern Greenland, below 68°N, these basins coalesce around the southern highlands. Most basins farther north coalesce toward the eastern highlands. One of the two largest basins terminates at Sermeq Kujalleq (Jakobshavn Isbræ). The authors say their network differs from that of Cooper and colleagues in 2016, since the southern highlands feed Akuliarutsip Sermia, about 100 kilometres to its south-west, rather than Sermeq Kujalleq.How could 3,031 branching angles reveal Greenland’s past climateThe authors analysed valley orientation using Hough transforms across 75-kilometre squares. They report a typically bimodal distribution of azimuths by drainage basin. South-west to north-east is most common in the CW, NW, NE and CE basins. South-east to north-west is next most common, in the SW, NW and SE basins. These orientations bear no clear relation to modern ice-flow directions. The study links the dominant south-west to north-east azimuth to a left-lateral shear pattern proposed by Beh in 1975. That proposal came with a "Wegener Fault" in Nares Strait, which the paper says was discarded once geological and structural observations precluded the fault. The authors state that parts of Greenland's plate may still have experienced shear after the Late Cretaceous, and that valleys may later have exploited this tectonic inheritance. They add that GNSS stations record differences in horizontal plate motion directions that are presently unresolved. 3,031 branching angles in the valley network, with a distribution peaking between about 50 and 65 degrees. This range is diagnostic of climates where groundwater flow or soil erosion are non-negligible but smaller contributors to channel incision than precipitation or surface runoff. They write that it implies an aridity index of about 0.1 to 1 during valley incision. Slipperiness is set to a uniform value over most of the ice sheet, which the authors say is unlikely to be accurate. However, varying it only changes the amplitude of the perturbations, so they are confident in the locations of the valleys if not their absolute relief. Disrupted basal units in the north prevented use of the method in places, and the authors highlight these regions as possible targets for future airborne radar surveys.You use AI every day. articles.title: Paid Rs 1.75 lakh for country club membership, but promised 2,000 sq ft plot not given; consumer commission orders Rs 3.25 lakh plus interest
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: The Delhi state consumer commission has directed a hospitality & holidays club to refund Rs 1.75 lakh paid by a customer for a lifetime
articles.body: NEW DELHI: The Delhi state consumer commission has directed a hospitality & holidays club to refund Rs 1.75 lakh paid by a customer for a lifetime membership after finding that the company failed to provide the promised membership benefits, including a 2,000 sq ft complimentary plot in Maharashtra. The commission also ordered Rs 1 lakh compensation for mental agony and harassment and Rs 50,000 towards litigation costs.Why did the customer file a complaint against country club?According to the commission order, the customer came across the company’s membership scheme in April 2008 after meeting its business promotion executives in Delhi.The company offered a lifetime membership for the customer and his family, along with holiday benefits and other facilities. One of the promised benefits was a complimentary 2,000 sq ft plot at Golf Village, Kolad, Maharashtra, near the Bombay-Goa highway.The customer opted for the “Mr. Cool Global Parivar Life Membership” for Rs 2 lakh and paid Rs 1.75 lakh after a discount of Rs 25,000.The company allotted a membership number but, according to the complaint, did not provide the membership card or other information within the promised two weeks. The customer said he repeatedly contacted the company but did not receive a satisfactory response.He approached the consumer commission alleging that the company had failed to provide the services promised under the membership scheme.However, the company argued that the complaint was not maintainable and was filed after a long delay. It also said the customer had not used the hotel or holiday package services.The company further claimed that the membership fee was non-refundable and that the customer had to pay annual maintenance charges to use the membership benefits.It also said the complimentary plot was subject to conditions, including payment of Rs 20,000 towards registration and other expenses, which the customer had not fulfilled. The company denied any failure in service and sought dismissal of the complaint.Why did the consumer commission find country club deficient in service?The bench of President Sangita Dhingra Sehgal and member Bimla Kumari found that the customer had paid Rs 1.75 lakh for the membership and that the company was required to provide the promised services, including the membership card and the 2,000 sq ft plot.The commission noted that the company had produced letters claiming that a complimentary site had been allotted to the customer. However, it found no proof that those letters had actually been delivered to him.“Moreover, it is clear from the email correspondence on record between the parties that the plot at Kolad, Maharashtra, was kept on hold by the Opposite Party,” the commission said.The commission also rejected the company’s argument that the customer had failed to pay registration and maintenance charges.The order said the company had not first shown that it had fulfilled its main promises under the membership scheme.“Therefore, we are of the view that the contention of the opposite party that the complainant was required to pay Rs. 20,000/- towards registration and other expenses for the complimentary plot and annual maintenance charges for availing the membership benefits, is also not sustainable,” the commission added.The commission concluded that the company had failed to provide the services promised under the membership.“Consequently, we hold that the opposite party was deficient in providing its services to the complainant, as it failed to render the services and facilities assured under the ‘Mr Cool Global Parivar Life Membership’, including issuance of the membership card and allotment of the complimentary plot measuring 2000 sq. ft. at Kolad, Maharashtra,” it said.Final order:The commission directed the company to:Refund the entire Rs 1.75 lakh paid for the membership.Pay 6 percent annual interest on the amount from April 11, 2008, to September 28, 2026, if the payment is made by November 28, 2026.Pay 9 percent annual interest from April 11, 2008, until actual payment if the amount is not refunded by November 28, 2026.Pay Rs 1 lakh as compensation for mental agony and harassment.Pay Rs 50,000 towards litigation costs.So, the company has been ordered to pay Rs 3.25 lakh in refund, compensation and litigation costs, apart from the applicable interest.

articles.title: Cat meat trade: 2,700 cats stolen in Vietnam for meat; police bust suspected theft ring
articles.summary: Police in Ho Chi Minh City have arrested 12 people accused of running a cat-theft and trafficking operation in which about 2,700 cats were allegedly
articles.body: Police in Ho Chi Minh City have arrested 12 people accused of running a cat-theft and trafficking operation in which about 2,700 cats were allegedly stolen and sold for meat. The cats were reportedly taken from residential neighbourhoods at night, with some eventually destined for slaughter, CBS News reported.The numbers are startling. But the details of how the alleged network operated make the case even more unsettling for pet owners.According to Vietnamese police, the suspects worked in small groups and travelled through residential areas on motorcycles between about 11pm and 4am. They allegedly used traps to catch cats that were roaming outdoors. Each group was said to capture around four to 10 cats a night before handing them over to a buyer.The operation came to light after police began investigating reports of pets disappearing from neighbourhoods in and around Ho Chi Minh City. Investigators eventually identified a network allegedly led by 39-year-old Luu Thanh Binh, who police say bought live cats and stored them before reselling them. VnExpress reported that the suspects admitted to stealing and trading approximately 2,700 cats, although authorities have not established exactly how long the operation had been running.For some families, the raid has brought a painful possibility: that a missing pet may not simply have wandered away.Authorities have so far identified the owners of 13 of the rescued cats and returned the animals to them. The remaining cats were moved to a social centre while efforts continued to identify their owners.The case also shines a light on a complicated issue in Vietnam. Consumption of dog and cat meat remains legal in the country, although sellers are required to have documentation showing the animals' origin. The legality of the meat trade, however, does not make the theft of somebody's pet legal. Vietnamese law treats dogs and cats as property, meaning stealing them can amount to property theft under certain circumstances.And this is not the first major cat-meat case to emerge from Ho Chi Minh City this year.Earlier this year, 400 cats were rescuedIn June, police rescued more than 400 cats in another operation targeting an alleged cat-meat crime ring. More than 500 cats were seized in total when animals found at different locations were counted. Some had been stolen pets, and more than 40 were eventually reunited with their families. Several cats died because of the harsh conditions in which they had been kept, according to animal welfare groups. The Associated Press report described the case as a reminder of the scale of the country's cat-meat trade.The June operation revealed just how quickly a pet can disappear into a larger supply chain. Police found dozens of cages containing live cats as well as containers holding dead animals. Animal welfare groups said some of the rescued cats were pregnant, with kittens later born while the mothers were in police custody.The latest investigation therefore raises a question that goes beyond one criminal network: what happens when an animal that is considered a beloved family pet in one home becomes a commodity somewhere else?For the families whose cats have been returned, the answer is painfully personal. They get to take a missing member of the household home again.For others, the search is still continuing.Get the latest movie news, reviews, and celebrity updates. Download the TOI App.

articles.title: Apple CEO John Ternus on how Steve Jobs’ ‘furniture story’ inspires product design at the company
articles.summary: Apple CEO John Ternus, who recently stepped into the top leadership position after guiding the company’s hardware engineering teams across multiple device
articles.body: Apple CEO John Ternus, who recently stepped into the top leadership position after guiding the company’s hardware engineering teams across multiple device generations, has shared how an iconic Steve Jobs philosophy continues to dictate Apple’s design standards – even on its most budget-friendly devices. Speaking soon after the launch of the MacBook Neo earlier this year, Ternus revisited one of his favourite stories about the late Apple co-founder, illustrating how attention to unseen details remains the foundation of the company’s product line.The ‘carpenter's lesson’Ternus recounted a quiet moment involving Jobs moving a bedroom dresser away from the wall.“Steve was moving a piece of furniture, a chest of drawers, and pulled it away from the wall and looked at the back and was just reflecting on the carpenter who had made it beautiful. It finished the back as beautifully as the rest of it, even though nobody was going to see it right and I think about that all the time because I think that perfectly exemplifies what we do here,” he said.The mindset of treating internal components and unseen surfaces with the same engineering precision as the exterior casing has been a foundational rule of Apple hardware since the earliest Macintosh models. Ternus connected that design ethos directly to the MacBook Neo, pointing out that cost-effective pricing does not mean cutting corners on aesthetic or structural integrity.“We've been talking about the MacBook Neo. Here is our most affordable Mac we've ever made, and it's absolutely beautiful. And if you open it up and look inside, it's just as beautiful,” Tetanus said.“And that's true about all products – an iPhone Pro Max or a MacBook Pro or an iPad Pro, but it's also true on a MacBook Neo,” he added, suggesting that Apple applies the exact same standards to its entry-level hardware.For Ternus, continuing to obsess over hidden details provides a clear roadmap for where the company is headed under his tenure.“That's what we do, and so, it's just been really good just to think about that and reflect on that because that is probably the best kind of clue as to where we're going in the future. We're going to keep pushing in that same way,” Ternus said.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.title: At least 22 dead after two boats collide on Congo River in DR Congo
articles.summary: At least 22 people were killed after two boats collided on the Congo River in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with rescue teams continuing to search for
articles.body: At least 22 people were killed after two boats collided on the Congo River in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with rescue teams continuing to search for survivors and recover bodies.According to a Reuters report, the collision took place near Ngombe in Lukolela territory in western Equateur province at around 2am local time on Saturday, provincial interior minister Crispin Mputu said. One of the vessels, a passenger boat, sank following the collision.The passenger vessel was carrying 163 people, according to a security source cited by Reuters. So far, 59 passengers have been rescued, while 22 bodies have been recovered and buried, Mputu said. The death toll could rise as some victims may have been buried elsewhere.The second vessel was a commercial boat travelling between Kinshasa and Mbandaka. The passenger boat was travelling from Mongala province towards Kinshasa when the collision occurred.The sunken passenger vessel remains underwater at a depth of around 12 metres, while recovery operations were continuing on Monday evening, Mputu said.Boat accidents are frequent in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where rivers serve as a major means of transport for communities and traders. articles.title: UIDAI announces new SOP for changing name on Aadhaar, here's what you need to know
articles.summary: UIDAI (Unique Identification Authority of India) has issued a revised Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for updating names in Aadhaar.
articles.body: UIDAI (Unique Identification Authority of India) has issued a revised Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for updating names in Aadhaar. The authority has introduced separate rules and documents requirements depending on the type of name change being requested. The new SOP, which came into effect on September 18, 2026, replaces the earlier process introduced in 2021. The updated procedure categorises requests into multiple categories, including minor spelling corrections, data-entry errors, surname changes after marriage or divorce, regional-language corrections and major name changes. According to UIDAI, documents, affidavits and Gazette notifications submitted with requests will be subject to stricter verification to prevent misuse and identity-related fraud.The basic rules for name change in AadhaarUnder the revised SOP, names recorded in Aadhaar must appear in block letters, with no titles, prefixes (such as Shri, Smt, Ms, Dr, or Prof), aliases, ranks, or special characters permitted. Updates are governed under Regulation 19 of the Aadhaar (Enrolment & Update) Regulations, 2016, and any name change must be backed by documents listed under Schedule II. A name will be updated exactly as it appears — in spelling, sequence, and abbreviation — in the document the applicant submits as proof.What counts as a minor Aadhaar name changeUIDAI treats several routine corrections as minor name changes, requiring only standard Proof of Identity (PoI), or Proof of Relationship (PoR) for children under 18:Expanding or abbreviating initials (for example, T R D Prasad becoming Tadi Rama Durga Prasad)Adding or deleting a middle or last nameChanging the sequence or order of an existing name (Divakar Anand to Anand Divakar)Minor spelling corrections (Ram to Rama)These are accepted as long as the new name matches a PoI or PoR document the applicant has already submitted to UIDAI in the past.Regional language errors get their own trackA separate category covers cases where the English spelling of a name on Aadhaar is correct, but the regional-language version contains an error — for instance, निर्मला being incorrectly recorded as निर्मल. These cases also require a standard PoI document to correct.Special cases with dedicated requirementsThe SOP carves out specific documentation paths for several commonly occurring situations:Marriage or divorce-related surname changes require an affidavit (Annexure D) along with PoI.Name changes due to gender transition require applicable PoI documentation.Updating a child's Aadhaar from "Baby of ___" to an actual name can be done on a Head-of-Family basis, with applicable PoR.Dropping ranks, designations, or prefixes, and removing random capital letters or dots, require no supporting documents at all.Removing an "urf" or alias entry requires an affidavit along with PoI or PoR.Major name changes need a Gazette NotificationThe strictest category under the new SOP covers a complete change of name or identity — for example, Ram Gupta becoming Shyam Gupta, or a more substantial identity shift. For these cases, UIDAI will accept only a Gazette Notification as proof, alongside standard identity documents; no other form of documentation is considered sufficient. The authority will also cross-check the proposed new name against every name previously recorded for that Aadhaar holder, and verify the authenticity of the Gazette Notification and any affidavits submitted.How many times can you change your name on Aadhaar cardUnder UIDAI's existing framework, a person can generally update their Aadhaar name twice in total. Once that limit is exhausted, any further name change requests must go through a separate exception-handling process. For context, gender on Aadhaar can typically be changed only once, and date of birth only once as well, under separate SOPs UIDAI maintains for those fields.What users need to do to for name change on Aadhaar cardTo apply for a name correction or change under the new SOP, applicants need to follow a set sequence of steps:Visit an Aadhaar Seva Kendra or Aadhaar Enrolment/Update Centre. the process requires an in-person visit; it is not currently available end-to-end online for most categories of name change.Fill out the Aadhaar Enrolment/Update form, writing the name in block letters, free of titles, aliases, or unapproved abbreviations.Submit the prescribed supporting documents based on the specific category the request falls under — ranging from a simple PoI for minor corrections to a mandatory Gazette Notification for a major name change.Complete identity verification and biometric authentication at the centre as part of the same visit.Pay the applicable demographic update fee, currently listed by UIDAI at ₹75 when a name update is processed as a standalone request.Collect the acknowledgement receipt, which includes an Update Request Number (URN) that can be used to track the status of the request online afterward.You use AI every day. articles.title: Oracle co-founder Larry Ellison bought an 8.4-acre Florida oceanfront estate for $80 million in 2021; five years later, after shelving demolition plans, he is asking $165 million for the property

articles.body: Larry Ellison, the co-founder of Oracle, is resisting his sprawling oceanfront estate in North Palm Beach, Florida for $165 million, more than double the $80 million he paid for the property in 2021, according to a report by the Wall Street Journal. This move from Ellison comes five years after the billionaire purchased the 8.4-acre estate and abandoned the plans to demolish the existing mansion. As per the WSJ report, the new asking price is around 14% higher than the $145 million price which the price at which the property was first listed in 2022. The estate is located within the exclusive Seminole Landing grated community in North Palm Beach. After acquiring the property in 2021, Ellison reportedly considered tearing down the Mediterranean-style mansion but never proceeded with the redevelopment. Instead, the estate remained largely unused while the billionaire focused on expanding other real estate holdings in South Florida.The latest $165 million asking price would set a record for North Palm Beach if achieved, reflecting the growing demand for ultra-luxury waterfront properties in the region.All about Larry Ellison’s oceanfront propertyThe estate's biggest draw is its land and beachfront access rather than the house itself. The property spans 8.4 acres and has 562 feet of Atlantic frontage, making it the third-largest oceanfront parcel in Palm Beach County. The main house has 16,284 square feet of living space, seven bedrooms, eight full bathrooms and five half-bathrooms. Other features include a swimming pool and spa, a tennis court, a four-car garage, direct beach access and a helipad. At $165 million, the price works out to more than $10,000 per square foot and about $20 million per acre. That would set a record for North Palm Beach.What the neighborhood market looks likeSeminole Landing sits next to the Seminole Golf Club. In 2020, private-equity billionaire Robert F. Smith bought a pair of houses there from energy drinks entrepreneur Russ Weiner for $48.19 million. Sales of $100 million or more have become almost routine in neighboring Palm Beach. Kenny and Kaneb said a market of $50 million and up is starting to take shape in North Palm Beach too. A property there sold for $55 million last year. Ellison's ask is three times that figure.Oracle co-founder Larry Ellison builds up his holdings in ManalapanThe relisting comes as Ellison builds up his holdings in Manalapan, an affluent town just south of Palm Beach, about 30 miles from the North Palm Beach estate. In June, he paid about $35 million for a parcel next to his roughly 15-acre compound there. He paid $173 million for the original compound in 2022. His Florida holdings also include housing for staff. In 2023, he spent almost $10 million to buy eight homes in a lakefront community in Boynton Beach, about 30 minutes from the Manalapan compound.Ellison's property portfolio also includes homes in Malibu, Calif., and Lake Tahoe, as well as the Hawaiian island of Lanai. He has recently been a major financial backer of Paramount's $81 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, the Journal reported.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. articles.title: “4 hours of work a day is enough…”: Chetan Bhagat explains why focused work matters more than long hours; “Prioritise everything you put on the table...”
articles.summary: For many employees, the workday is measured by the time spent in the office. Popular author Chetan Bhagat has suggested looking at it differently.
articles.body: For many employees, the workday is measured by the time spent in the office. Popular author Chetan Bhagat has suggested looking at it differently. It is not by counting every hour at the desk, but by asking how much genuinely focused work gets done. Speaking at the 18th Project Management South Asia Conference (PMSAC26) in Bengaluru recently, the writer said four hours of dedicated work can be enough. “I work 4 hours a day and that is enough if you do it with full dedication,” Bhagat said at the event. He was also clear about what he meant by a four-hour workday. The four hours, according to Bhagat, should refer to actual work and not the time employees spend dealing with meetings, breaks, technical problems or other interruptions. “If you genuinely do work for 4 hours in a day, that is enough, good enough,” he said.What Bhagat said about the 4-hour workdayBhagat’s argument was not that employees should simply spend four hours at work and stop. His focus was on what happens during those hours. “It doesn't mean you have to include meetings, breaks, Wi-Fi issues, and other hunky-dory stuff that the offices often witness,” he said. Instead, he suggested that employees should concentrate on the work that actually needs to be done. “In those 4 hours, you have to prioritise everything you put on the table,” Bhagat said. The difference is particularly relevant in corporate workplaces, where a working day can include meetings, calls, messages, administrative tasks and other interruptions alongside the work an employee is expected to complete.Bhagat’s remarks come at a time when the idea of long working hours is being debated in India, while artificial intelligence is also changing the way companies think about productivity and jobs.Bhagat also spoke about work-life balanceBhagat was also asked about maintaining work-life balance. His response was linked to the ideas he discusses in his book 11 Rules for Life. “No one cares for you unless you are, do what makes you feel happy, follow 11 rules of life,” he said. The book discusses areas including health, sleep, priorities and taking action rather than continuously waiting for the right time. For Bhagat, the idea of productivity appears to be connected to deciding what deserves attention and then giving it that attention rather than simply extending the number of hours spent working.Four hours versus long workweeksThe comment also adds another voice to India's ongoing debate over working hours. Infosys co-founder NR Narayana Murthy has previously argued that India's young workforce should work longer hours, including his widely discussed call for a 70-hour working week. That position has become part of a broader debate over whether longer working hours necessarily translate into higher productivity. Bhagat's argument points in the opposite direction: that the time spent working should not automatically be treated as a measure of output. His four-hour figure is his personal view on focused work, rather than a proposal that every workplace should legally or formally adopt a four-hour working day. The larger question remains whether productivity should be judged by how long someone stays at a desk or by what they actually accomplish.Get the latest movie news, reviews, and celebrity updates. articles.title: Nigerian Air Force plane crash: Bola Tinubu declares three days of mourning as 25 killed
articles.summary: President Bola Tinubu describes the crash as a "painful moment" for the military and the entire nation.
articles.body:
Nigeria's President Bola Tinubu has declared three days of national mourning after a military aircraft crashed in southern Ondo State, killing 25 people.

Aviation Minister Festus Keyamo on Monday said 32 people had died but on Tuesday the Air Force clarified that 25 people had been killed - five crew and 20 passengers.

Authorities say the plane was on a routine mission from Benin City to Lagos when it came down in a swamp near a naval base on Monday morning. After reaching the site, the aircraft was found to be submerged under water, officials said.

A resident told the BBC that clothes and shoes had been found at the site. Smoke could be seen rising from the area.

It is the deadliest crash involving a Nigerian military aircraft since 1992.

The Nigerian Air Force has released the names of those killed, showing that 19 of those on board were military personnel.

Tinubu offered his deepest condolences to those killed and has ordered a full investigation.

The president also ordered national flags to be flown at half-mast across the country as a mark of respect for those who died.

"This is a painful moment for our Armed Forces and for the entire nation," Tinubu said.

"Our Air Force personnel put their lives on the line every day to secure Nigeria. Their sacrifice will never be forgotten," he added.

The aviation minister earlier said he had been informed "of the disappearance of a military aircraft with tail number NGR 931, enroute Lagos from Benin at 0913 hours earlier today".

Keyamo said "efforts to raise the aircraft on radio proved abortive" before subsequent confirmation that it had crashed near a naval base in Igbokoda, Ondo state.

He said search and rescue efforts were ongoing.

The crashed plane, described as an ATR-42 aircraft, carries between 30 and 50 passengers, according to its manufacturers.

Tinubu has ordered the Air Force to immediately begin a thorough investigation into the cause of the crash to help prevent similar incidents in the future.

The Nigerian Air Force plays a key role in the country's military operations, including efforts to tackle armed groups and insecurity in several parts of the country.

In May 2021, Nigeria's army chief, Lt-Gen Ibrahim Attahiru, was killed in a plane crash alongside 10 other officers in the north-western state of Kaduna amid bad weather.

In February of the same year, seven people died after a military plane crashed short of a runway in the capital Abuja.

articles.title: Quebec separatists vowing independence vote win provincial election but fall short of majority
articles.summary: The separatist Parti Québécois won Quebec’s provincial election Monday but fell short of enough seats to govern alone, returning to power with a promise to hold another referendum on independence from Canada.
articles.body: The separatist Parti Québécois won Quebec’s provincial election Monday but fell short of enough seats to govern alone, returning to power with a promise to hold another referendum on independence from Canada. The result returns Paul St-Pierre Plamondon’s party to power for the first time in more than a decade but denies it the majority it sought, forcing the separatists to rely on opposition parties even as they try to revive Quebec’s independence debate. The party was on track to win nearly 60 seats as the final votes were counted, falling short of the 64 needed for a majority in Quebec’s 127-member National Assembly, the provincial legislature. A minority government means PQ will need support from opposition lawmakers to pass key legislation and survive confidence votes. St-Pierre Plamondon acknowledged that voters had denied his party a majority. “Quebecers elected the Parti Québécois asking it to work with the other parties, and I heard that message,” he said. Leader wants an independence vote He has pledged to hold another referendum on independence, though he has said he would wait until US President Donald Trump is no longer in office. St-Pierre Plamondon framed independence as essential to preserving Quebec’s French-speaking identity, saying it was a “question of survival” for a French-speaking population that represents only a small fraction of North America. He said Quebec “just wants to exist on its own like other countries of the world” and that a referendum would allow Quebecers to decide their own future. “I continue to dream and visualize that country,” St-Pierre Plamondon said in his victory speech. “That dream will be realized one day.” He also sought to reassure Canadians outside Quebec. “The project for independence is not about excluding you,” he said. “Quebec will never change its geographical position, so we have an interest in working together.” Coalition Avenir Québec leader Christine Fréchette conceded defeat, saying voters had made their choice and that she took full responsibility for the “difficult result.” The CAQ, which entered the election with 79 seats, was shut out of the legislature, and Fréchette lost her own seat in Trois-Rivières. Victory is not a mandate for independence But the PQ’s victory does not mean most Quebecers support leaving Canada. “This was not an election about independence, which is not popular in Quebec right now, but about getting rid of the CAQ, the party in power since 2018,” said Daniel Béland, a political science professor at McGill University in Montreal. Support for independence remains at about 30%, low by historical standards, he said. Béland said the minority result is likely welcome news for Prime Minister Mark Carney’s government because it could make it harder for the PQ to prepare for and eventually call an independence referendum. The PQ would face opposition from both the Liberals and Conservatives, whose leaders have said they would fight efforts to hold a sovereignty referendum. Québec solidaire, another pro-independence party, could hold the balance of power and potentially support the PQ on a referendum. Carney congratulated St-Pierre Plamondon and signaled that Ottawa would work with the incoming separatist government. “Building a stronger Québec is core to our mission of building a stronger Canada,” Carney said. He said the two governments would work together to support businesses and workers affected by US tariffs, create jobs and build housing. Quebec result adds to Canada’s national-unity questions Still, Béland said a separatist government in Quebec poses a new national-unity challenge for Carney, particularly with another independence-related vote approaching elsewhere in Canada. The Quebec result comes two weeks before Albertans vote October 19 on whether to hold a referendum on separation from Canada. “Seeing that a pro-independence party won in Quebec barely two weeks before an independence-related referendum takes place in Alberta might suggest to the Trump administration that national unity remains a major issue in Canada despite the popularity of Mark Carney,” Béland said. Quebec voters have twice rejected sovereignty, most recently by a razor-thin margin in a 1995 referendum. Quebec, which is about 80% French-speaking, already has significant autonomy. The province of 9.1 million collects its own income tax, has immigration policies favoring French speakers and has laws giving the French language priority over English. Even with the PQ victory, Trump’s tariffs and 51st-state rhetoric have complicated the separatist argument by stirring Canadian nationalism and giving some French-speaking Quebecers another reason to value remaining part of Canada. Trump’s tariffs and repeated threats against Canada became a defining issue in the 2025 federal election, helping lift Carney’s Liberals to victory after the party had trailed badly before Trump returned to office.

articles.title: Lego fraudster among last year's most high-profile insurance scammers
articles.summary: The person was sentenced to 28 months in prison after an investigation found the claims were made up, the insurance trade body, the ABI said.
articles.body:
A scammer jailed for making false home insurance claims about supposedly stolen Lego has been listed as one of last year's most high-profile insurance fraudsters.

The person was sentenced to 28 months in prison after an investigation found the claims were made up, insurance trade body the ABI said.

Other insurance fraud cases flagged by the ABI include someone who staged car crashes with people they met online and a complex travel insurance scam involving multiple fake identities and documents.

The average value of a fraudulent claim reached £14,300 last year, the second-highest level on record, the ABI said.

There were £1.34bn worth of fraudulent claims in 2025, a 14% increase on the £1.18bn detected the previous year.

At the same time, the number of detected fraudulent claims fell slightly to 93,900, down 2.7% on 2024.

Mark Allen, head of fraud and financial crime at the ABI, said: "Although the rate of detected insurance fraud fell slightly last year, our data shows that fraudsters are targeting much bigger payouts.

"As emerging technologies such as AI become more widely available, fraudsters will continue to look for new ways to exploit them."

Det Ch Insp Simon Klust, head of the Insurance Fraud Enforcement Department (IFED) at the City of London Police, said: "Insurance fraud is not a victimless crime and those who commit it increase the cost of premiums for honest customers."

He added that the 250 cases a day detected by the ABI last year were "unfortunately likely to be just the tip of the iceberg".

Macbooks, fishing equipment and Lego sets

One of the most notable fraudsters identified by the ABI last year was a man found by IFED to have fabricated reports of stolen high-value Lego sets .

The man's scam claims to Axa Insurance during 2021 and 2022 also included other high-value items such as MacBooks, televisions, gaming consoles and fishing equipment, IFED said.

In 2023, IFED said it found collectible Lego sets matching the ones claimed to have been stolen displayed in the man's living room during a search.

Alongside his prison sentence handed down last year, he was also ordered to repay the £14,000 he had claimed.

Other cases highlighted by the ABI included a man jailed for 20 months for manipulating women he met on dating sites into participating in staged car crashes, and a man sentenced to four and a half years for submitting over £300,000 worth of fraudulent travel medical emergency claims.

In general, the ABI said motor insurance remained the area where insurers identified the most fraudulent cases, accounting for 55% of all scam claims.

Meanwhile, the ABI's figures found that exaggerated loss remains the most common type of insurance fraud, with 26,900 cases identified.

This is when someone deliberately attempts to increase the cost of a claim beyond its true value, the ABI said.
